mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 68 degrees with light drizzle near the Military Ridge State Trail and we are under a waning gibbous moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to 63 degrees and rain is predicted.

In city news, a stretch of Hwy M will be closed to traffic from October 6 through October 9 to allow for final road improvements. Also, if you need to vote early for the November 3 election, you can head to the City Clerk's office during the two-week period leading up to Election Day.

You have plenty of local fun ahead! Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Lou-ee Trivia are both taking place today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, live music at Paddy Mac's, or join in for trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for the retail theft of Swedish Fish candy from a shop on East Verona Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
